description: Merge layers — choose with `mode`. `visible`: collapse all visible layers into one (DESTRUCTIVE; identities lost). `stamp`: merge visible into a NEW layer on top, leaving originals intact (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+E — the non-destructive "final tweak" composite for output sharpening/grain/contrast; prefer this when building on top rather than collapsing). `flatten`: flatten ALL layers into the background (DESTRUCTIVE; transparency filled with bg color — use sparingly, usually prefer `visible` or exporting a flattened copy). Returns context.

mode.description: visible: collapse all visible layers into one (DESTRUCTIVE; identities lost). stamp: merge visible into a NEW layer on top, originals kept (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+E — non-destructive "final tweak" composite). flatten: flatten ALL layers into the background (DESTRUCTIVE; transparency filled with bg color).

name: ps_merge
